pre_existing_findings.suggested_fix: Under the existing administrator/embed/demolab gate, initialize continuity with a fresh in-memory state/store before any ordinary private read. Scope demo summaries to the sample form, exclude sensitive nodes, and capture an explicitly shareable output node. Verify successful and failed demos leave seeded regular storage byte-identical with zero regular reads/writes and send no roster, contact or medical sentinels to demoSave.
pre_existing_findings.title: Continuity demos read, replace and upload private kit data
pre_existing_findings.why_it_matters: An authorized embedded continuity demo opens the ordinary owner-scoped store, replaces only the sample form and generated folders, and retains private local data. The generic input summary can capture rendered sensitive rows before the kit is cleared, while whole-kit HTML capture retains roster links and letter/contact text. demoSave receives that captured input and HTML; the sample also writes to the regular private draft. The identical continuity UI and recipe are already in c187604 and unrelated to the local reconciliation, so this remains an upstream-only finding outside the primary integration verdict.

pre_existing_findings.title: Continuity sources appear before document end
pre_existing_findings.why_it_matters: When a teacher opts to attach sources and prints the full continuity kit, the routine source list appears before the emergency, student, and update folders. This breaks the project's rule that sources belong at the end of the document.
